messages:
maria_gomez: Heads up — Intouch (acct intouch@intouch.health) reports being charged twice for their annual renewal. They submitted a PO (PO-8891) and then paid manually with a card when the PO approval was delayed. Need urgent refund + invoice cleanup. :rotating_light:
ajay_kapoor: Can you paste the two txn ids and the invoice numbers? I want to check settlement window and whether one can be voided before settlement.
maria_gomez: Customer provided these: card charge `ch_3K9b7X` (2025-05-12 14:03 UTC) and PO payment webhook `tx_7bC2n` tied to invoice `INV-2025-8891`. They attached receipts and noted the VAT amount differs between the two.
billing_bot: Payment webhook received: tx_7bC2n status: settled; gateway_ref: gw_7781; invoice: INV-2025-8891; tax_amount: 120.00 EUR
ajay_kapoor: Both look settled on our side. If so, we'll need to issue a refund and generate a credit note for bookkeeping. Proposal: refund the manual card payment so the PO remains as the invoice of record. @lee_ops any objections?
lee_ops: Ok to refund the card payment. Finance needs to issue the credit note to preserve VAT reporting. I'll open a FIN ticket and coordinate. Suggested refund command for ops queue:
```
refund --payment ch_3K9b7X --amount 1020.00 --reason "Accidental second payment - annual renewal"
```
maria_gomez: Customer expects: (1) refund of the accidental card payment, (2) corrected invoice showing only the PO with VAT 20%, (3) confirmation when accounting is updated. They flagged that the card receipt currently shows 0% VAT.
sophie_support: I'll confirm billing country and address with the customer before ops proceeds. VAT depends on billing address; need that for the credit note. Messaging them now.
lee_ops: FIN ticket FIN-4562 created. Finance ETA ~24 hours to issue credit note and replacement invoice. Once credit note is posted, ops can trigger refund and attach refund tx id to the invoice.
ajay_kapoor: Noted — I'll wait for FIN-4562 to be resolved and then queue the gateway refund. Please paste the refund tx back here so I can mark it in the billing portal.
maria_gomez: I'll reply to the customer with the 24-48h timeline and confirm we will refund the card and issue corrected invoice. :white_check_mark:
sophie_support: Customer confirmed billing address (United Kingdom) and acknowledges timeline. They also asked whether tax will be adjusted on their end or we issue the credit note — I told them finance will handle the credit note and we will send the corrected invoice.
lee_ops: Once refund goes through, ops will run this quick reconciliation script against the account to ensure invoices and credit notes net to zero for the duplicate renewal:
```
python tools/reconcile_account.py --account intouch@intouch.health --since 2025-05-01
```
ajay_kapoor: Perfect. I'll post refund tx id here when complete.
maria_gomez: Thanks team — keeping this on my radar until FIN-4562 closed and refund visible.
sophie_support: Marking follow-up reminder for 48h. :calendar:
